$comment: Read by bin/fleet-route. For each role, candidates are tried in order; the first whose harness is installed, signed in and under its limits wins. Only the models in `allowed` may be used: Claude Code Opus, agy Gemini 4 Neon and agy Claude Opus 5.5. Roles differ by effort, not by model. Claude Code takes the effort as --effort; agy model ids carry it (gemini-4-neon-high). Set claude-code limits after comparing `fleet-route usage` with /usage in Claude Code; null means not calibrated (treated as available).

plan.description: Planning, architecture, discovery and the top of an implementation: product-owner, tech-lead, developer.
